import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=2)

# Extract columns
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_x = data[:, 1]
msd_y = data[:, 2]
msd_z = data[:, 3]
msd_total = data[:, 4]

# Convert steps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps, data recorded every 100 steps
time = steps * 0.001 * 100 / 100  # = steps * 0.001

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='Total MSD')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_vs_time.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, use the linear regime
# Typically after initial transient (let's use data after 50 ps to be safe)
linear_start_time = 50  # ps
linear_start_idx = np.argmax(time >= linear_start_time)

# Use data from 50 ps onwards for linear fit
time_linear = time[linear_start_idx:]
msd_linear = msd_total[linear_start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t + intercept
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_linear, msd_linear)

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6 (in Angstrom²/ps)
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Angstrom = 10^-10 m
# 1 ps = 10^-12 s
# 1 Angstrom²/ps = (10^-10)² m² / (10^-12 s) = 10^-20 / 10^-12 = 10^-8 m²/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\n=== Diffusion Coefficient Analysis ===")
print(f"Linear regime: {linear_start_time} ps to {time[-1]:.1f} ps")
print(f"Number of data points used: {len(time_linear)}")
print(f"\nLinear fit: MSD = {slope:.6f} * t + {intercept:.6f}")
print(f"R² value: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"  D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Å²/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer (m²/s): {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Plot with linear fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='Total MSD', alpha=0.7)
plt.plot(time_linear, slope * time_linear + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.3f})')
plt.axvline(x=linear_start_time, color='g', linestyle=':', linewidth=1.5, 
            label=f'Linear regime start ({linear_start_time} ps)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'MSD Analysis - D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_analysis.png', dpi=150)
plt.close()

print("\nPlots saved: msd_vs_time.png, msd_analysis.png")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"="*50 + "\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Å²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"\nLinear fit parameters:\n")
    f.write(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Å²\n")
    f.write(f"  R²: {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"\nLinear regime: {linear_start_time} ps to {time[-1]:.1f} ps\n")
